title: How do I make variable numbers correspond to names?

posts.author: krispindahood
posts.body:
Forgive me if this is well known and I just haven't looked hard enough, but I don't really know what else to do. I'm using SumRndmDde's HUD Editor, and one of the things I hope to accomplish with the editor is nameplates for the character that's currently talking. The way I hope to implement this is through a variable, where each value of that variable corresponds to a character's name, and depending on the variable's current value, the corresponding name is displayed. Thing is, I have no idea how to implement this, outside of some primitive-feeling eventing like constantly running if-else common events or having multiple names loaded on the HUD editor that change whether or not they're displayed depending on the variable.
Does anyone have any ideas?

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
Considering that the value must be listed starting from
1
, then it would be like this to know the current name of the actor in the list:
$gameActors._data[1].name()
$gameActors._data[2].name()
$gameActors._data[3].name()
And to see the current value of a variable the function would be this:
$gameVariables.value(id)
Example of use:
$gameVariables.value(1)
$gameVariables.value(3)
$gameVariables.value(200)
So let's say the variable used would be 50, you would just do this:
JavaScript:
$gameActors._data[$gameVariables.value(50)].name()
